newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE SUGAR SLEEPY IN PRE-EASTER RANGE TRADING.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE SUGAR SLEEPY IN PRE-EASTER RANGE TRADING.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures passed a quiet late afternoon session comfortably within its well established trading range.
"It was unlikely to do anything else so close to the long Easter week-end,' a trader said.
London is closed until Tuesday, April 1.
At 1830 GMT prices were between $0.50 a tonne lower and $0.70 higher and turnover totalled 2,187 lots.
There was no news from physicals to influence the market and one trader reckoned that "There's so much sugar floating around. On a fundamental basis you have to say it should come down........"
Paris May ended at $305.20 a tonne, down $0.90.
